newsitem.title: INDIA: Hindustan Lever drives up Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Hindustan Lever drives up Delhi shares.

text.p: Heavy purchases by foreign institutional investors and domestic mutual funds in Hindustan Lever drove Delhi share prices to a higher close on Tuesday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 12.55 points higher at 802.93.
Hindustan Lever rose 65.00 rupees, or 5.72 percent, to 1,201.00 rupees on foreign buying and short-covering by speculators, brokers said.
"Franctic buying by overseas investors for the second session running has completely changed the market scenario," said B.K. Nagpaul of brokerage B.B. Portfolios.
ITC, after moving in alternate bouts of buying and selling, ended 0.50 rupee lower at 479.50.
Reliance Industries closed 0.80 rupee higher at 305.05.
